### Issues

[CR-R13-1][statement-contradiction][MEDIUM][HIGH] `fields` pinning contradicts explicit `fields:[]` on default-mode skip/override rows
File: `.scratch/token-efficient-tool-responses/ticket05-spec-r13.md:12` (also :36, :37, :52, :66, :90, :91, :153)
Confidence: HIGH
Issue: R2 :12 and the open-(i) decision :37 require "the entry DEFAULT list on every default-mode row (**apply or skip**)", yet the r13-amended CR-R12-1 row :36 writes row 6 as `mode:default, fields:[]`; AC1 :90 (override, `mode:<producing mode>` = default on the direct path) and AC2 :91 write `fields:[]`; §10 :153 repeats `fields:[]` as CR-R12-1's falsifiable oracle. D-table row 6 :52 and row 20 :66 emit P without any `fields` value, so the rule governs them, and it says default list. The trailing category "rows with no selection" (:12/:37/:143/:154) is not disjoint from "every default-mode row" — every default-mode row lacks a field selection — so rows 6/7/9/20 are claimed by both branches. The choice is also asymmetric with rows 15/17, where a skip carrie…
Consequence: T1's decision function and schema oracle (":103, :108 default-mode rows carry the entry default list") cannot satisfy AC1's override fixture (:90), AC2's (:91) or §10's (:153) `fields:[]`; README/logging-contract disclosure text would state both. Engineer cannot author one passing unit — the same class of non-authorable fixture that made CR-R12-1 blocking.
Fix: pick one rule and align every site. Recommended: default-mode skip/override rows carry the entry default list (the attempted projection) — change `fields:[]` to the entry default list at :36, :90, :91, :153 and state `fields` explicitly in D-table rows 6, 7, 9, 20; delete "rows with no selection" from :12, :37, :143, :154 (full-mode and no-match rows already cover `[]`). If `[]` is intended instead, re-pin :12/:37/:154 as "[] on every default-mode skip row", change rows 15/17 to `[]`, and update AC6(a')/T1/T2 oracles to match.
